version_rule: decide at implementation from the then-current version; this draft does not bump

items.title: 化石の発掘（ES1-035）の山札の側

event.card_id: card_id of the shown card itself at generation

acceptance: F1 card_id correct for viewers 0,1,spectator,host; equals view record
F2 no uid-card_id pair to non-owners before acceptance
N6 identify=True call sites exactly 20; helper default False

items.title: スロットゲーム（neo1-090）の束
items.change: add field card_ids at the same add_event

card_ids.value: card_ids[i] == card_id of uid cards[i] at generation
card_ids.duplicates: kept per position; never merged or sorted
card_ids.masking: not a uid field; cards[i] may be masked to null per viewer, positions unchanged

event.consistency_with_taken: each following reveal_from_deck in the same acceptance has card in cards and card_id == card_ids at that position

items.generation_point: after the first shuffle, before moving cards to hand; fixed at generation, never backfilled
items.short_deck: TOP1 UNRESOLVED_DECK_TOP_SHORT before use; no bundle event; empty bundle never generated
acceptance: S1-S4 length/order/value for 2+1, 3 same, 3 same card_id, no pair, name variants
N3 own-only bundles and private searches unchanged
N4 before/after equal except added card_id/card_ids
N5 old-format records load without backfill

old_format: read as unidentified; never infer from uid, later state, known decks, or names

gui_followup.F: existing revealed-cards panel; pin bump and contract description only
S: validate card_ids string array with len == len(cards); cards int or null; reject partial
one row: player showed top 3: name+ID in event order
no card_ids: 3 cards without identification; unknown ID per card
keep baseline note and per-viewer logs
